failure_description: Radiated emissions at 120 MHz exceeded RE102 spacecraft limit curve by 3.2 dB due to unshielded camera flex cable.
root_cause: Preliminary prototype camera harness lacked 360-degree conductive backshell termination at the chassis connector.
corrective_action: Replaced flex ribbon with double-shielded twisted pair cable and Amphenol MIL-DTL-38999 360-degree ground collar.
